types.name: Draft
types.doc: A saved draft (drafts contract section 5). A host's backend stores it as is in server mode; in device mode it is encrypted whole.

members.name: answers
members.doc: Including hidden answers, as in the open form. Repeating groups as arrays of instances, in order, without instance ids (drafts contract section 5).

members.name: idempotencyKey
members.doc: So a resumed form cannot create a duplicate submission.

types.name: DraftMode
types.doc: Where a draft lives (drafts contract section 2): the tab's sessionStorage (today's behaviour), the browser's IndexedDB, encrypted, or the host's own backend.

types.name: DraftRef
types.doc: Which draft a host's server functions are asked about: one per (scope, formId).

members.name: scope
members.doc: Opaque to the package: identifies the user and, where it matters, the subject.

types.name: DraftsSettings
types.doc: The author's choice, stored in the schema. Exported only when not "session".

types.name: DraftsUnavailableReason
types.doc: Why drafts fell back to "session" (drafts contract section 4).
